bibl.title: Sculpture in Native Egyptian Stones in Julio-Claudian Contexts.
bibl.seg: Robert Steven Bianchi, Sculpture in Native Egyptian Stones in Julio-Claudian Contexts.
bibl.note: Deals with the stone anciently termed basanite and its identification, with particular attention paid to its privileging by members of the Julio-Claudian dynasty for their images, suggesting reasons for its choice and possible interpretations of its meaning. Passes in review the ability of classically trained sculptors to create works in native, Egyptian hard stones in a classicizing idiom which, among other factors, contributed to the Hellenization of Roman Egypt.
